verses.text: Don’t you be afraid, for I am with you. Don’t be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you. Yes, I will help you. Yes, I will uphold you with the right hand of my righteousness.
Haven’t I commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid. Don’t be dismayed, for the LORD your God is with you wherever you go.
The LORD is my light and my salvation. Whom shall I fear? The LORD is the strength of my life. Of whom shall I be afraid?
Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me. Your rod and your staff, they comfort me.
When I am afraid, I will put my trust in you. In God, I praise his word. In God, I put my trust. I will not be afraid. What can flesh do to me?
I sought the LORD, and he answered me, and delivered me from all my fears.

God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble. Therefore we won’t be afraid, though the earth changes, though the mountains are shaken into the heart of the seas; though its waters roar and are troubled, though the mountains tremble with their swelling.
He who dwells in the secret place of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty. I will say of the LORD, “He is my refuge and my fortress; my God, in whom I trust.”

He will cover you with his feathers. Under his wings you will take refuge. His faithfulness is your shield and rampart. You shall not be afraid of the terror by night, nor of the arrow that flies by day.
For he will put his angels in charge of you, to guard you in all your ways.
The LORD is on my side. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
The LORD will keep you from all evil. He will keep your soul. The LORD will keep your going out and your coming in, from this time forward, and forever more.
He will not be afraid of evil news. His heart is steadfast, trusting in the LORD.
I laid myself down and slept. I awakened, for the LORD sustains me. I will not be afraid of tens of thousands of people who have set themselves against me on every side.
In peace I will both lay myself down and sleep, for you alone, the LORD, make me live in safety.
Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid or scared of them, for the LORD your God himself is who goes with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you.
The LORD himself is who goes before you. He will be with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you. Don’t be afraid. Don’t be discouraged.

But now the LORD who created you, Jacob, and he who formed you, Israel, says: “Don’t be afraid, for I have redeemed you. I have called you by your name. You are mine. When you pass through the waters, I will be with you, and through the rivers, they will not overflow you. When you walk through the fire, you will not be burnt, and flame will not scorch you.”
For I, the LORD your God, will hold your right hand, saying to you, ‘Don’t be afraid. I will help you.’

Don’t be afraid, for you will not be ashamed. Don’t be confounded, for you will not be disappointed. For you will forget the shame of your youth. You will remember the reproach of your widowhood no more.
Behold, God is my salvation. I will trust, and will not be afraid; for the LORD, the LORD, is my strength and song; and he has become my salvation.
For God didn’t give us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.
There is no fear in love; but perfect love casts out fear, because fear has punishment. He who fears is not made perfect in love.
For you didn’t receive the spirit of bondage again to fear, but you received the Spirit of adoption, by whom we cry, “Abba! Father!”
What then shall we say about these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?
So that with good courage we say, “The Lord is my helper. I will not fear. What can man do to me?”
Peace I leave with you. My peace I give to you; not as the world gives, I give to you. Don’t let your heart be troubled, neither let it be fearful.
But he said to them, “It is I. Don’t be afraid.”
But immediately Jesus spoke to them, saying, “Cheer up! It is I! Don’t be afraid.”

Aren’t two sparrows sold for an assarion coin? Not one of them falls to the ground apart from your Father’s will. But the very hairs of your head are all numbered. Therefore don’t be afraid. You are of more value than many sparrows.
But Jesus, when he heard the message spoken, immediately said to the ruler of the synagogue, “Don’t be afraid, only believe.”
The angel said to her, “Don’t be afraid, Mary, for you have found favour with God.”
But the very hairs of your head are all counted. Therefore don’t be afraid. You are of more value than many sparrows.
Don’t be afraid, little flock, for it is your Father’s good pleasure to give you the Kingdom.

When I saw him, I fell at his feet like a dead man. He laid his right hand on me, saying, “Don’t be afraid. I am the first and the last, and the Living one. I was dead, and behold, I am alive forever and ever. Amen. I have the keys of Death and of Hades.”

Moses said to the people, “Don’t be afraid. Stand still, and see the salvation of the LORD, which he will work for you today; for you will never again see the Egyptians whom you have seen today. The LORD will fight for you, and you shall be still.”
After these things the LORD’s word came to Abram in a vision, saying, “Don’t be afraid, Abram. I am your shield, your exceedingly great reward.”
The LORD’s angel encamps around those who fear him, and delivers them.
The LORD of Armies is with us. The God of Jacob is our refuge.

In that day, it will be said to Jerusalem, “Don’t be afraid, Zion. Don’t let your hands be weak.” The LORD, your God, is amongst you, a mighty one who will save. He will rejoice over you with joy. He will calm you in his love. He will rejoice over you with singing.
You are my hiding place. You will preserve me from trouble. You will surround me with songs of deliverance.
You are my hiding place and my shield. I hope in your word.
Don’t be afraid of sudden fear, neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it comes; for the LORD will be your confidence, and will keep your foot from being taken.
The fear of man proves to be a snare, but whoever puts his trust in the LORD is kept safe.
Though an army should encamp against me, my heart shall not fear. Though war should rise against me, even then I will be confident.
Be strong, and let your heart take courage, all you who hope in the LORD.
He alone is my rock and my salvation, my fortress. I will not be shaken.
You will keep whoever’s mind is steadfast in perfect peace, because he trusts in you. Trust in the LORD forever; for in the LORD, the LORD, is an everlasting Rock.
Whoever fears the Lord won’t be afraid, and won’t be a coward, for he is his hope.

The angel answered the women, “Don’t be afraid, for I know that you seek Jesus, who has been crucified. He is not here, for he has risen, just like he said. Come, see the place where the Lord was lying.”

messages.text: Do not be afraid. Those are the words God speaks again and again in the Bible. He speaks them to you now.
Courage is not the absence of fear. It is trusting God while you are afraid.
Jesus walked on the water and said, Take heart, it is I; do not be afraid.
Whatever you are facing, you will not face it alone.
Pray to Saint Michael the Archangel. He defends God's children in battle.
Fear shrinks when you name it before God. Tell Him exactly what scares you.
The Lord is your light and your salvation. Whom shall you fear?
You are under the shadow of God's wings. Nothing can reach you there without passing through His love.
Perfect love casts out fear. Let God love you until fear loses its grip.
Your guardian angel is beside you right now. Ask for his protection.
Mary was greatly troubled when the angel came, but she said yes to God. He will give you courage too.
God has not given you a spirit of fear, but of power, love and a sound mind.
If you are in danger, please get help now: call 999 or 112, or go to someone you trust.
Even when you walk through the darkest valley, God's rod and staff comfort you.
Fear looks at the size of the problem. Faith looks at the size of God.
Make the Sign of the Cross slowly. It is a shield of faith.
The angels at the tomb said, Do not be afraid. Christ is risen. Death itself has been defeated.
Saint John Paul II began his papacy with the words, Be not afraid. They are for you too.
God counts every hair on your head. You are precious in His sight.
Pray the Memorare. No one who fled to Mary's protection was ever left unaided.
You can feel fear and still take the next step. God will steady your feet.
Christ holds the keys of death and the grave. Nothing is outside His power.
Breathe deeply and say: The Lord is with me; I will not be afraid.
God goes before you, and He will be with you. He will not fail you or forsake you.
The Israelites stood at the sea with an army behind them. God made a way. He can make a way for you.
When fear keeps you awake, pray Psalm 91 and rest under God's protection.
Your future is in safe hands, the hands of the One who loves you most.
Fear is a feeling. God's faithfulness is a fact.
Ask a friend to pray with you. Courage grows in company.
Saint Joan of Arc was young and afraid, yet she trusted God's call. God gives strength for what He asks.
Jesus said to the frightened father, Do not fear, only believe.
The battle belongs to the Lord. Let Him fight for you.
God is your refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
Even if the earth shakes and the mountains fall, God remains your safe place.
Take courage. God's Spirit is among you, so do not be afraid.
Hold a crucifix or rosary and remember that love has already won.
Be strong and courageous. Not because you are strong, but because God is with you.
When you feel small, remember that God loves to work through small and humble hearts.
Fear of tomorrow fades when you live today in God's presence.
The Lord will keep you from all harm. He will watch over your going out and your coming in.
God calmed the sea for the disciples. He is not asleep in your storm.
Let God's peace stand guard over your heart and mind.
You do not need to have courage for the whole road, only for this step.
Fear not, for I am with you. Say it slowly, and let God say it to you.
Saint Michael the Archangel, defend us in battle. Be our protection.
The safest place in the world is the will of God.
Jesus was afraid in Gethsemane, and He prayed. You can do the same.
Every brave saint was once afraid. They trusted God anyway.
God's love is a fortress. Run into it and be safe.
Rest tonight. Angels watch over you, and the Lord is your keeper.
